name: Guided Discoveries Summer Camp
description_short: A nature camp run by Squam Lakes Natural Science Center in Holderness, NH. Children spend time outdoors learning about local wildlife and New Hampshire ecosystems through exploration, group games and hands-on activities, using the center's Live Animal Exhibit Trail and forested campus.
refund_policy_summary: A $25 administration fee applies to all cancellations. Cancel more than 30 days before a session: full refund minus $25. Cancel 14–30 days before: 50% refund minus $25. Cancel less than 14 days before: no refund. If enrollment is low, the center cancels week-long programs on the Wednesday before the start date and gives a full refund. Families may also transfer to another session at no extra cost if space allows.
